Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionGet ready for a bright adventure full of strategy in Candlemates! Control two enchanted candles and push the fire stones onto their matching braziers, but be careful: each candle has a limited number of moves, and every step can make all the difference! Switch between the two characters to take advantage of their positions, create paths, and complete each puzzle. While one candle is active, the other remains still and can even be pushed like any other object in the environment. Use both wisely, plan your moves, and avoid wasting precious steps too soon! As you progress, new challenges make the puzzles increasingly complex. Pressure plates, stone barriers, and other obstacles require precise movements, careful planning, and perfect coordination between the two candles. And don't be afraid to experiment! With Undo and Restart options, you can test new strategies and try again whenever something goes wrong. Light up your strategy, coordinate your candles, and find the perfect path to illuminate every brazier!Show morePublished byAfil GamesDeveloped byAfil GamesPlay withXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesSingle playerOptimized for Xbox Series X|SXbox achievementsXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionExperience the magic of a true American Christmas! Get ready for a journey through snowy America, from bustling cities to cozy little towns, the spirit of the holiday is in the air. Garland lights sparkle, Christmas carols sound, and the smell of hot cocoa with marshmallows fills the air. In Christmas Across America, you’ll find two intertwining stories: — Santa and his cheerful elves go on a festive tour across the U.S. to deliver gifts and magic to children from California to New York. — And little Lily and her family prepare for Christmas the way millions of Americans do: decorating the house, visiting friends, taking part in charity events, and creating family traditions that will stay in the heart forever. Take a walk through Christmas markets, go ice skating in Central Park, visit Santa’s house in Alaska, hop on a holiday train, and feel the atmosphere of those heartwarming classic holiday movies we all love as a family. Game features: - A journey across the U.S. on Christmas Eve — 38 locations, each capturing the spirit of the region and the holiday - An American family story — Lily, her parents, neighbors and friends come together to create a Christmas filled with care, warmth and traditions - Holiday hidden-object scenes — decorations, letters to Santa, Christmas toys, treats, greeting cards, angels - Dozens of mini-games — decorate the house, help pack gifts, launch the Christmas train, create a snow angel - Collections and meta-progression — collect souvenirs from every state, decorate Lily’s house, unlock family recipes and stories This game is like a warm letter from the past and a gift for the whole family. Wrap yourself in a blanket, pour some cocoa, and start your journey through Christmas America. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionLuxury. Romance. Ocean. Feel the sea breeze and the endless horizon! This is the beginning of a grand journey. For the first time, you step aboard a luxurious liner to spend an unforgettable honeymoon! In Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey, warm encounters and cozy evenings await, as your route takes you through the colorful islands of the Pacific Ocean. This isn't just a sightseeing tour, it's a celebration of life, where every day brings new emotions. Why you'll love this game: -Engaging storylines! From the care and love of newlyweds to the developing relationship between a distinguished captain and a female manager. -A carefree atmosphere: join parties, play in the casino, and enjoy diving in the Pacific waters. -Collect memories: Gather unique souvenirs from ports of call — memorable keepsakes from every destination you visit. -Rich bonus search content: Beyond the main item list on each location, a whole set of additional items awaits you! This isn't just a game. It's a lifestyle: with new friends, carefree moments, and the atmosphere of a daily celebration. Ocean, luxury, and love are just a moment away. Collector's Edition includes: -18 additional hidden object scenes — even more cozy locations and details to explore. -12 new mini-games + 18 bonus games — for those who love a challenge along the way. -A souvenir collection — gather unique mementos from every port, like true traveler's trophies. -Beautiful desktop wallpapers and a music player with a wonderful soundtrack.
